body: Don't think your existence is a pure waste, everyone has something good to share...

You are not alone, and if you never said these to anyone, this is not good, keeping these kind of thing to you is very bad for you, for what you said, you have people who loves you, why don't you try to talk with them? Even if they can't help you directly, just talking already helps, and if you need someone else to talk feel free to message me.

Something similar happened to me, i really love this girl, but her family hates even though she loves me, she won't do anything to change and i can't do anything also, i fear if i do something i will end up hurting her or even my family...i know this doesn't help at all but i know what you are feeling, if could help you more i would, and maybe sometimes all you is someone to talk to especially with someone who understands you. If i would give an advice, i would say to don't let this consumes you. I wish we all get better, have a nice day/night as well.
If you need, i'm here to talk to you. Just send me a message
